fields.outcome: Developers and content collaborators can generate and maintain modular product walkthroughs whose unaffected sections remain reusable after application changes.
fields.scope: Parent epic for authorized application connection, browser capture, modular manifests, annotated screenshots, dependency-aware invalidation, selective regeneration, DOM replay, video, and publishing. Delivery is split into child stories; this record is not an implementation ticket.
fields.acceptance: The child story map covers the product requirements with explicit dependencies, exclusions, verification, and traceability to the parent outcome.
fields.decisions: Deliver the first proof as an authenticated fixture journey, stable capture manifest, and annotated screenshots. Defer DOM replay, video, and publishing adapters until the maintenance loop is proven.
fields.verification: Validate child-story coverage with ah-validate-scope and assess each child independently before implementation.
fields.dependencies: Child work st-01 through st-03 for the first proof; later dependency mapping, invalidation, replay, video, and publishing stories.
fields.risks: No external customer evidence exists yet. The epic spans multiple independent outcomes and must remain decomposed.

criteria.expectation: The product accepts an authorized application target, secret references, and a plain-language journey goal.
A captured journey is represented as stable, independently replaceable modules.
Content collaborators can review generated narrative and visual outputs before publication.
Recorded dependency evidence can identify which modules are affected by an application change.
Affected modules can be regenerated and assembled with unchanged modules.
Secrets and private captures remain outside committed and published artifacts.
